decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects
in accordance with the proposals contained in the application
and the plans submitted and numbered Existing Plans: 301A,
302, 304, Received 19 December 2011, 303B, 305B, 306B,
307D, Received 20 March 2012, 308A, Received 8 February
2012, 309, Received 19 December 2012, Environmental Noise
Survey ? Report 11/1480/R1/Revision 1, Plant Noise
Assessment Memorandum, Received 8 February 2012,
Additional Statement, Received 8 February 2012, Design and
Access Statement, Planning and Retail Report, Received 19
December 2012 therewith and approved by the Local
Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in
writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is
used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers
outside the following times [0700-2300].

Condition : 4 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed
without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No development shall commence before a delivery and
servicing management plan for the site has been submitted to
and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The
delivery and servicing arrangements shall be carried out in full
accordance with this plan unless otherwise agreed beforehand
in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the existing retail unit, following demolition of part of ground floor and structures to the rear
